workflow.action: Identify exact current RDC hub/brake part set with wheel type and revision. Keep wheel axle and brake camshaft separate.
Get same-part side profiles and both axial ends, plus cam-foot end view; record spline profile and measured/dimensioned sections.
Create axial diameter/length stack from verified dimensions; label each still-estimated segment, never scale exploded illustration as drawing.
Lathe shaft steps and shoulders, make spline from verified pitch/count, construct cam foot from documented section; keep cam isolated and editable.
Compare clean machined shaft and treated cam appearance under neutral/raking lights; original textures only or licensed data.
Verify journals/seals, spline engagement with actual lever, two shoe contacts and neutral/operating angle. Do not call a free-rotation animation a functional brake test.
Check evaluated export sections, scale, pivot, normals, and actual geometry in Babylon.js.
Produce measured game LOD after shape correctness; compare end views and spline silhouette.
Present isolated source-bound real renders and limits for user reception.

next_action: Resolve the exact RDC assembly before detailed cam geometry; keep existing wheel-brake candidates unreconciled and unaccepted. Cockpit work can progress independently.
